sermon.title: God’s Rest part 2 — June 30, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: Continuing God’s rest: Israel rested from war under Joshua and the elders, but another generation arose that did not know the Lord. God wants to plant His people in Zion, His resting place, which is the church. He gives rest from enemies such as depression and drugs through praise and the word, and there remains a rest of ceasing from our own works, which we enter diligently.
